authority.limitation: This is the first executable product slice for GB 55037-2022. It checks only an explicitly classified IfcDoor against the verified clear-opening minimum in Clause 7.1.4(1). It is a deterministic pre-check and evidence report, not statutory certification or professional sign-off. Door swing direction, building use, occupant load, floor or underground depth, number of exits, total egress width, and geometry-derived applicability are not inferred.
